method: For every quiet-tape conditioned decision, all 66 pre-event warehouse bars (5-session path + 60-session envelope + anchor) must have row-level updated_at <= entry_date 13:30:00Z (entry session open). updated_at is the last write clock, so passing rows prove the exact bytes read today were already in the warehouse before the decision entry; any later rewrite fails the decision closed.
unresolved_vintage_caveat: updated_at proves content identity at entry only for rows never rewritten after entry; it cannot recover what an even earlier vintage looked like, and split/dividend adjustments before the last write are invisible. Conclusions from this surface are therefore capped at research_pit / observed_only lead.
